columns.name: WORKLOAD_PLAN_ID
columns.description: Primary key identifiying the publish event record by a system generated ID

columns.name: WORKLOAD_MODE
columns.description: The import type will indicate either 'T' for time based imports or 'S' for shift based imports.

columns.name: SHIFT_ID
columns.description: Shift ID

columns.name: WORKLOAD_PLAN_CODE
columns.description: Unique identifier for a record provided by the user

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: ENTERPRISE_ID

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to support soft delete. Value 'Y' indicates that the record is deleted. Null or 'N' values indicate the record is not deleted.

columns.name: WORKLOAD_TYPE
columns.description: Workload import type

columns.name: SKILL_ID
columns.description: Skill ID

columns.name: SHIFT_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Indicates whether the shift is Regular or On-Call or any custom shift type

columns.name: SCHED_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Scheduling Unit ID

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start of the date range for which the window plan is defined

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End of the date range for which the workload plan is defined

columns.name: START_TIME_OFFSET
columns.description: Start time of the workload plan saved as offset in minutes from the day start

columns.name: END_TIME_OFFSET
columns.description: End time of the workload plan saved as offset in minutes from the day start

columns.name: INPUT_SOURCE
columns.description: Record source, either import or UI

columns.name: WORKLOAD_VALUE
columns.description: Workload value

columns.name: WORKLOAD_UOM
columns.description: Unit of Measure for the Workload Vaue

columns.name: ORIGIN_SYSTEM_REF
columns.description: External source system for an imported workload plan

columns.name: SOURCE_SYSTEM_KEY
columns.description: External source system ID for the workload plan

columns.name: WORKLOAD_IMPORT_TAG
columns.description: Optional tag to identify an imported set of records

columns.name: MON_FLAG
columns.description: Monday is part of day of week for this workload

columns.name: TUE_FLAG
columns.description: Tuesday is part of day of week for this workload

columns.name: WED_FLAG
columns.description: Wednesday is part of day of week for this workload

columns.name: THU_FLAG
columns.description: Thursday is part of day of week for this workload

columns.name: FRI_FLAG
columns.description: Friday is part of day of week for this workload

columns.name: SAT_FLAG
columns.description: Saturday is part of day of week for this workload

columns.name: SUN_FLAG
columns.description: Sunday is part of day of week for this workload

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
